changes.text: CRM pipeline for deals, stages, and activities. It stays hidden until a user is given a CRM role, and deals are not Tyme projects.
Editing an organization uses tabs for details, color, departments, and contacts. The dialog keeps a steady height, and long lists scroll.
The Users list shows one access chip per module instead of every role.
Deleting a contact, intranet page, menu item, or signature asks for confirmation. Organization and CRM notes stop at 500 characters.
Intranet page images load again. The Drive folder check no longer gets canceled before the picture is downloaded.
Intranet images that are already on a page load even when they are not inside the current Intranet folder. A failed image is requested once, not on every redraw.
The CRM list loads. It was failing because the API could not create the CRM function, and the client retried that error.
Expenses: draft, submit, and reimburse reports with receipts on App Shared Drive. Submit files a statement PDF under Expenses / Filed that is kept if the person is later deleted.
Stopwatch List / Week: week view groups time by day; a tab under each row shows start, stop, and duration.
Intranet files use App Shared Drive (same App Drive as Expenses), not a pasted IT Resources folder or a personal Drive token.
Organizations Maintenance role is now Manager. Admin is global-only; User Access assigns roles and does not operate a module.
Expenses roles: User:Expenses, Manager:Expenses, and UserAccess:Expenses for role assignment.
App Drive refresh no longer shrinks the Shared Drive token. Stopwatch Week dates stay in UTC. User delete respects recent expense reports.

Regression tests that fail CI if App Drive refresh uses employee Drive scopes, Stopwatch Week dates are not UTC, same-name people share an expense folder, User Access is treated as Manager, or user delete ignores recent expenses.
Dashboard Favorite pages is available whenever you have Intranet access, even with none starred yet. Add and remove pages on the tile.
Expense line Description can be typed again. Category Code sits next to Category, not under Date.
Intranet images load from App Drive even if the Intranet folder lookup fails. App Drive token refresh no longer sends an empty scope list.
Google Calendar settings are grouped (Connection, What syncs, Event colors, Pull missed events). Stop Calendar sync ends import/export without forgetting the Google credential.

Calendar reconnect no longer reports a failed connect when live import cannot start (localhost has no public webhook). Disconnect keeps the stored token so Google missing refresh_token on reconnect does not 400.
Only OOO/PTO is ignored and shown off when both export and import are off. Connect dialog copy matches Settings.
Intranet Drive images only load if the file is under the Intranet folder on App Shared Drive, so expense receipts cannot be streamed via a page.
Google Calendar pull no longer stacks duplicate Tyme rows when an organizer updates a recurring invite. Unlinked leftovers only relink for the same series, time, and name.
Availability categories can be busy-only: they still show on Team Availability, and they do not count as Tyme hours. Vacation and Sick keep counting. Only a Tyme manager can turn hours off.
Tasks Week and Project views no longer treat a busy-only all-day block as 8 hours.
Management hides busy-only rows. Changing From or To reloads the Project list from time actually logged in that range for the selected employees.
Google Calendar Connect is Calendar-only. Intranet Drive uses a separate consent so Google's consent page no longer returns Backend Error for some Workspace accounts.
Settings → General and Tyme tabs, with auto-save. Favorites are no longer cleared when saving Tyme settings.
Only Availability projects and optional remove of leftover Google events when a project stops syncing. Export-off keeps the GoogleEventId so turning export back on does not duplicate.
Resume live import when the push watch expired. Calendar reconnect messaging when Drive needs a separate reconnect or sync did not start.
All-day multi-day spans show inclusive dates and this week's hours (not 23:59). Week empty state is full width. Submitted-month dialog links to Submit.
Projects Download CSV of names and calendar slugs. Project name max length is 100.
LOCAL bar on localhost debug ports only (7047 / 5047 / 11256), with Hide 5 min.
Help → Availability covers manager-defined categories and Only Availability personal sync.
A repeating Google Calendar event with a project [slug] no longer imports every week for decades. Tyme only takes tagged events in the next 90 days. Each night it fills the next 90 days.
Submit no longer lists far-future months from those repeating events — through next month only.
Cancelling a repeating Google series matches every imported week, not only one instance.
Week → List shows a lock on stopwatch sessions in a submitted month, same as other tasks.
Product version display stays at 1.0.0 (greenfield). GitHub release tags increment separately.
